THE PENNSYLVANIA STATE UNIVERSITY
University Park, Pennsylvania

July 29, 1964

Members of the Conference Committee
18th National Conference on the Administration of Research

Gentlemen:

I have just been in touch with Ray Woodrow and we might have a sell-out crowd for the 18th NCAR meetings at Princeton. As of the most recent tally, we now have the following breakdown:

75 Industry

125 University

70 Government

This gives us a grand total of 270!

In following up on the recent letter from J. I. Thompson requesting that members of the Committee make an effort to encourage industrial attendance, would you please drop Ray Woodrow a note if you have a positive answer from anyone interested in attending. Ray's address is:

Princeton University
Box 172

Princeton, New Jersey 08540

This factor of total attendance carries a note of urgency because of the somewhat limited housing facilities in Princeton. Ray would appreciate your letting him know as quickly as possible.

[SIGNATURE]

Robert H. Ramsey

Secretary-Treasurer

National Conference on the
Administration of Research

R/s

cc: Ray Woodrow

1004857872
